principles: DeepSeek + pinned DSH remains the only agent kernel
No local model weights, training, GPU serving or second patient database
AI selects and interprets; code performs arithmetic and preserves inputs
An unavailable operation does not withhold other research or erase partial results
Uncertainty and missing evidence are represented, not fabricated

remaining: v1 is marginal endpoint-by-horizon output. Joint event trajectories and multimodal model training are not implemented or represented as present.

remaining: Only the generic cloud protocol is tested. Configure and probe an actual licensed provider. Cost is provider-reported; unknown charges cannot be bounded by a client-side estimate.

Re-predict from a new history or model while preserving prior versions
Per-row numerical meaning checks with partial retention

remaining: AUROC/AP use observed-at-horizon cases. IPCW uses marginal independent-censoring assumptions; conditional/competing-risk models and full trajectory-distribution scores require a separate model contract.

tasks.title: Keep predictive, parameter, model and Monte Carlo uncertainties distinct
remaining: Model and parameter uncertainty remain not estimated unless the external provider supplies the corresponding distribution. Patient bootstrap does not replace these.

tasks.title: Replay perturbations, freshness and local split shift diagnostics
Independent preserved-evidence RCT benchmark machinery
remaining: Requires rights-cleared independent trial predictions, preserved result sources and declared trial-family identities. No HealthFlux benchmark or clinical replication is claimed.

tasks.title: Dynamic endpoint forecasts at requested horizons
Paired model scenario contrasts with explicit causal limits
Translate saved common-subject forecasts to the existing design engine
Reuse prognostic adjustment and connect heldout correlations to PROCOVA design
remaining: Actual patient-level binary/survival adjustment uses the existing externally supplied, prespecified score-column workflow. This adapter does not relabel a forecast as an observed trial outcome or claim EMA qualification. Real clinical use needs independent validation and trial-specific pre-randomization inputs.

tasks.title: Predicted outcomes never become observed matching facts
Separate trial-effect models from patient trajectory predictions
remaining: No new treatment-effect model is trained or served locally. The module evaluates externally supplied trial-effect outputs; it does not infer causal identification from forecast differences.

tasks.title: Integrate history, import, versions and validation into the patient tab
Update all five DSH skills, existing tools and report number sources
T2D pilot across literature, longitudinal and imported-prediction paths
remaining: The executed pilot is authored synthetic data and a real DeepSeek API through pinned DSH. It is not real patient validation or a live dedicated world-model service.

tasks.title: Test arithmetic, permissions, provider failures, UI and real DeepSeek/DSH execution
remaining: Full hosted production deployment, real partner prediction service and prospective clinical validation are outside this isolated branch acceptance.

reviewRemediation.scope: All twelve source-review findings; isolated branch implementation and engineering acceptance.

findings.title: Forecast versions are absent from design job identity
findings.resolution: Computation identity includes immutable prediction and validation ids, horizon and randomization time alongside the queue-owned scenario hash. Inputs with equal numbers but different provenance cannot reuse an old design.

findings.title: New imported forecasts do not invalidate a cached export
findings.resolution: Both document kinds bind to longitudinal metadata digests. Input cover and report projections read through repeatable-read snapshots; a concurrent import does not leak into an earlier report.

findings.title: Trial benchmark target alignment omits arm and horizon
findings.resolution: Preserved quotes anchor the endpoint timepoint and arm. Import aligns trial, endpoint, scale, unit, arm, arm role and horizon; mismatched or unknown targets are local exclusions.

findings.title: Per-horizon validation denominators omit missing predictions
findings.resolution: Each horizon starts from the eligible frozen history population. Evaluated, missing forecast, invalid forecast and missing outcome counts partition the requested population.

findings.title: One malformed provider row discards valid peers
findings.resolution: A valid batch envelope preserves valid peers, original exchanges, per-row rejection identities and receipts. Replay reuses preserved rows without another provider charge.

findings.title: Synthetic zero-event validation is hidden by generic suppression
findings.resolution: Only platform-owned synthetic summaries bypass generic small-cell display suppression. Real small cells retain a horizon and display reason; mixed-source histories stay patient data.

findings.title: Recent-record limit can hide histories still referenced by predictions
findings.resolution: Metadata supports pagination and exact-id/parent-id reads. Related histories and latest evaluations remain reachable; cumulative batch checkpoints collapse in lists but remain individually addressable.

findings.title: Trial benchmark has no researcher or DSH import entry
findings.resolution: Researcher upload and DSH workspace-file import both create a benchmark id. The engine reads actual effects only from preserved evidence, retaining the external prediction content identity.

findings.title: Predictive samples cannot supply available design variance
findings.resolution: Declared predictive samples supply within-subject sample variance with n-1 denominator. Parameter draws and single samples do not. Real R design and PROCOVA consume the derived design inputs.

findings.title: Increasing survival probabilities are accepted without a finding
findings.resolution: Survival probability increases are recorded as rejected cells; consistent horizons and other subjects remain usable.

findings.title: Validation UI hides baselines and incomplete-result explanations
findings.resolution: The page shows denominator partitions, same-subject baselines, unavailable distribution inputs, local exclusions and interruptions, with refresh and older versions. The AI receives explicit per-baseline directions without a new delivery gate.

findings.title: Automatic model-analysis document tables exclude longitudinal results
findings.resolution: Frozen model plans and generated reports include longitudinal identity, model version, validation, coverage, baseline and trial-benchmark tables whose numbers bind to the saved report model.

remainingExternalDependencies: A callable dedicated forecasting provider and its actual protocol probe.
A partner incremental endpoint and cursor contract.
Independent rights-cleared longitudinal outcomes, RCT benchmark and Chinese extraction references.

functionalReview.scope: Revisited the full conversation, supplied paper and OpenMed adoption decisions; cloud APIs and user uploads, DeepSeek + DSH only. No production deployment.

closedGaps.title: Incident event risk sets
closedGaps.result: Exclude confirmed prevalent patient events from incident validation and the calibration baseline; report original and eligible denominators separately. Explicit all-subject/recurrent-event estimands remain selectable.

closedGaps.title: Multimodal missing-input sensitivity without cohort attrition
closedGaps.result: Preserve mapped modality and row-level kind, omit modalities explicitly, retain subjects without observations in API batches, imports, validation denominators and lineage. Protected unablated evaluation context retains site membership and prevalent exclusions without sending omitted inputs to the provider.

closedGaps.title: Usable sensitivity, model-version and observation-update comparisons
closedGaps.result: Compare paired subjects at common calendar targets across histories, model versions and landmark updates; record unmatched coverage, changed factors and conditional-risk window differences. UI queues the comparison and retrieves completion.

closedGaps.title: Multi-endpoint upload with partial retention
closedGaps.result: One external file can carry up to 32 independently addressable endpoints. Invalid components do not erase valid peers. Templates, patient-tab endpoint selection, evaluation and design use the same existing routes. This is explicitly marginal output, not a jointly sampled generative path.

closedGaps.title: Site-specific validation and explicit independence meaning
closedGaps.result: Optional validation by recorded input site uses the same frozen split and denominator logic; unknown/multiple sites persist. Local calibration partitioning is explicitly distinct from unknown provider training overlap.

closedGaps.title: Stable report references and complete presentation
closedGaps.result: Every saved record exposes a stable numberPath; report_model has an id-indexed summary map. Multi-endpoint import, incident exclusions, site evaluations and paired version comparisons render automatically with existing suppression semantics and export snapshots.
